once.notice: Copy it now: it will not be shown again. Argos stores only a hash.
once.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
once.passwordChange: Give it to the user over a private channel. They choose their own password at the first login.
once.previousValid: The previous token keeps working until {{time}}.
once.store: Save it in the token file on each host (permissions 0600), never in argos-agent.yml or a repository.

apps.readOnly: Read only: changes need the administrator role.

editor.groupHelp: Groups the application on the overview. Leave empty for none.
editor.apdexHelp: Requests up to T are satisfied, up to 4T tolerated. A change applies to new transactions only.

invalid.name: Enter a name of 1 to 128 characters without control characters.

invalid.group: The group has at most 64 characters, without control characters.

pending.title: Pending registrations
pending.description: Agents of an application that is not registered yet, in an environment that does not register automatically. Approve to create the application and issue its token; the agents connect on their next retry.
pending.approveImpact: Creates the application and issues one agent token, shown once. Agents of the request connect on their next retry.
pending.rejectImpact: Removes the request. The agent keeps retrying, so it comes back unless the agent is stopped or reconfigured.
pending.noToken: The application was created, but it has 5 active tokens already, so no token was issued. Revoke one on the Tokens screen and issue a new one.

empty.title: No registration is waiting.
empty.description: Agents of unregistered applications appear here when their environment asks for approval.

instances.title: Instances
instances.autoArchive: Instances without a connection for {{days, number}} days are archived automatically; a reconnect lists them again. Only archived instances can be deleted.
instances.archiveConnected: Only an instance that is not connected can be archived.
instances.archiveImpact: Hides the instance from the instance list. Its data stays; a reconnect lists it again.
instances.deleteImpact: Deletes the archived instance and its command history. Its events and collected data stay until their retention ends.

noApp.title: No application yet.
noApp.description: Register an application on the Applications screen, then attach an agent.

empty.title: No instance of this application.
empty.description: Attach the agent with the install guide of the application; its instances appear here when they connect.

emptyArchived.title: No archived instance.
emptyArchived.description: Instances are archived after 7 days without a connection, or by an operator.

collection.title: Collection health ranking
collection.help: Totals over the selected time range. A dash means no source, not zero.

empty.title: No instance reported collection data in this range.
empty.description: Widen the time range, or check that the agents are connected.

tokens.title: Agent tokens
tokens.help: Agents authenticate with a token of their application. A badge marks tokens that expire within {{days, number}} days.

empty.title: No token for this application.
empty.description: Issue a token and save it in the token file of each host before attaching the agent.

tokens.issueImpact: A new token for this application. It is shown once; Argos keeps only its hash.
tokens.rotateImpact: Issues a new token, shown once. The current token keeps working for {{days, number}} days so that you can replace it on every host.
tokens.revokeImpact_one: The token stops working at once. Its {{count, number}} live agent session ends within 5 seconds.
tokens.revokeImpact_other: The token stops working at once. Its {{count, number}} live agent sessions end within 5 seconds.
tokens.revokeSessions_one: {{count, number}} live agent session ends immediately.
tokens.revokeSessions_other: {{count, number}} live agent sessions end immediately.
tokens.reason: Reason (required, kept in the audit log)

install.title: Install guide:
install.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
install.token: Save the application's agent token in {{file}} on each host (owner only, permissions 0600). The token is never part of these snippets.
install.addressNote: The collector address is the host this browser reached, port 9100. If agents reach Argos through another address (proxy, NAT), use that one; the token issue answer shows the configured address.
install.javaagentHelp: Add these options to the application's JVM, for example in JAVA_OPTS.
install.ymlHelp: Put the settings in argos-agent.yml next to the agent jar and start the JVM with {{line}}.
install.checkHelp: Runs on the host without attaching to the application: configuration, token file, collector connection and supported libraries.
install.compat: Supported JDKs, servers, frameworks and drivers: section "Compatibility targets (1.0)" of README.md in the Argos distribution, and docs/agent-config.md for every agent setting.

canary.one: Attach the agent to one instance first.
canary.selfDiag: Check that its self-diagnosis reports no error and it is UP on the Instances screen.
canary.compare: Compare its response time and error rate with an instance without the agent for a while.
canary.rollout: Then roll out to the remaining instances.

users.title: Users
users.selfDelete: You cannot delete or disable your own account.

empty.title: No users.
empty.description: Create a user with the role they need.

noMatch.title: No user matches this name.
noMatch.description: Change or clear the name filter.

users.createImpact: Argos generates an initial password, shown once. Give it to the user privately.
users.mustChange: The user must change the password at the first login
users.roleImpact: The user becomes {{role}}. Their sessions end now and the new role applies at the next login.
users.enableImpact: The user can log in again.
users.disableImpact: The user cannot log in, and their sessions end now.
users.piiGrantImpact: The administrator can view full bind parameters; every view is audited.
users.piiRevokeImpact: The administrator can no longer view full bind parameters.
users.sessionsImpact: Every session of the user ends now; open pages return to the login.
users.unlockImpact: Lifts the lockout after failed logins.
users.resetImpact: Sets a new password the user must change at the next login. Their sessions end now.
users.passwordHelp: At least {{min, number}} characters; the server also refuses common passwords.
users.deleteImpact: The account is anonymised and disabled and its sessions end. The audit log keeps its name. The last administrator cannot be deleted.

revert.title: Revert this change?
revert.impact: The values the server held before this change are pushed to the same instances at once. Keys it did not hold before are removed from the server configuration; agents keep the pushed value until their restart or a reload.

history.caption: Configuration changes of the application, newest first
history.emptyDescription: Changes made here or with the kill switch appear in this list.

killSwitch.title: Kill switch
killSwitch.stateOn: The kill switch is on: the agents of this application do not trace.
killSwitch.stateOff: The kill switch is off: the agents trace normally.
killSwitch.impactOn: its agent stops tracing at once (no transactions, SQL or profiles are recorded); the application keeps running unchanged; metrics and the session stay; the instance shows WARN until the kill switch is turned off.
killSwitch.impactOff: its agent resumes tracing at once and the WARN state clears.

retention.applied_other: Saved and applied. {{count}} partitions are dropped in the background.
